_notes: Locally added for the leaderboards of VPX -- upstream pinmame-nvram-maps has no map for Taito do Brasil games.
Found by watching every byte of the RAM (0x3E00-0x40FF) through an automated game (Doc/test-hooks/score-probe.py), played by TopGun (2019),
a table running this ROM; checked against the displays of the backglass (067348, 051839, 051875).
Scores: the score display 0x4080-0x408B (PinMAME taito.c, dma_display), 3 bytes of packed BCD per player, least significant first,
blank digits 0xF. After a game, the attract mode borrows these bytes for text about 5 s after the game over flag is set.
player_count 0x408F (0 after a game); current_ball 0x408C; game_over bit 0 of 0x409F (set by PinMAME's NVRAM handler at boot too).
